architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable components in src/components/. Static assets in public/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management library (local state sufficient).

tickets.title: Create Hero Landing page (sugidev_hero_landing)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable Button, Badge components from button_showcase_component_reference, badge_showcase_component_reference. Use Tailwind classes for styling. Preserve animations/interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Button, Badge components reusable across app

tickets.title: Create Showcase Explore section (sugidev_showcase_explore_section)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Use existing Button, Badge components. Implement grid layout for project cards. Add hover effects as in design.
acceptance_criteria: Project cards responsive (3-column desktop, 2-column tablet, 1-column mobile)

tickets.title: Create Marquee About section (sugidev_marquee_about_section)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Implement marquee animation using CSS. Extract reusable Marquee component if used elsewhere.

tickets.title: Create Services & Projects page (sugidev_services_projects)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Use existing Button, Badge components. Implement tab switching for Services/Projects. Add project filtering if present in design.
acceptance_criteria: Tab switching works without page reload
Project filtering functional if in design

tickets.title: Create Footer section (sugidev_collection_footer_section)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable Footer component. Add social media links. Ensure copyright year auto-updates.

tickets.title: Create Contact & Inquiry pages (contact_clean_background, project_inquiry_clean_background)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React components. Implement form validation. Add form submission handler (mock API). Extract reusable FormInput component.
acceptance_criteria: Form validation works (required fields, email format)

tickets.title: Create Insights page (insights_clean_background)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Implement blog post grid. Add filtering/sorting if present in design. Extract reusable Card component.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App component. Set up React Router with routes for all pages. Implement navigation bar with active state. Add 404 page. Ensure smooth page transitions.
